acceptance: Automatically start coordination after authentication while page remains open; no companion enable/pause switches
Microphone start/stop controls listening only, not work follow-up; navigation keeps coordination; lock/page close stops it
Prioritized task, blocker, reminder and authorized-message overview with deduplicated meaningful notices; quiet when unchanged
Stable work-first role and preserved user personality preferences
Focused lifecycle/backend tests and actual Safari UI acceptance; update local runtime only
No permanent speech-reply toolbar or playback-status strip; saved settings control actual speech output

requirements.summary: User removes autonomous enable switches and prioritizes work coordination, companionship only when idle. Prior page-open scope retained.

design.summary: Reuse existing execution pipeline and page watch as heartbeat; separate work monitor from microphone; display ordered work ledger and deduplicate meaningful events. No idle model loop or silent new jobs.

implementation.summary: Work follow-up auto-starts after identity verification with no companion switches; microphone and background navigation separated; work-first persona and prioritized read-only ledger; meaningful notifications and network backoff. Custom personality data untouched. Follow-up UI feedback removed both redundant speech bars. Saved voiceReplyEnabled is authoritative; only blocked playback shows a temporary action notice. Stopping speech does not stop the coordinator.

verification.summary: 115 quick checks pass, including saved-setting speech gating and no permanent normal-playback toolbar. Targeted server race/vet passed. Native Safari after identity verification automatically showed 2 followed tasks and their completed/cancelled states; final simplified UI visibly has neither redundant toolbar. Live task-switch continuity and actual voice barge-in were not accepted in this turn; their lifecycle paths have unit coverage. Final restart requires normal identity revalidation for protected history/follow-up.

documentation.summary: Documented automatic work coordination, microphone isolation, read-only heartbeat, lifecycle boundaries and OpenClaw sources. Updated settings description/locales.

cleanup.summary: Existing user tabs, work history, identity controls, settings and data mounts preserved. No fixture containers or developer tools left open. No git reset/stage/commit/push.

release.summary: Local update/restart complete; healthy image sha256:004375fd542c501f6507bd0a7635c3774430adf47f3782e756939b9791e69000. app.js v183, assistant-live.js v4, conversation.css v11. No remote publication.
